intro: Choose a camera and algorithm. Required models and packages are prepared automatically with default recognition settings.
offline: The gateway is offline or unavailable. Reconnect it before deploying recognition.
noCamera: No camera is available. Connect and enable a camera first.
noAlgorithm: No deployable algorithm is available. Ask an administrator to publish the required resources.
summary: Reuse {installed} installed resources and install {pending} resources. Recognition starts when all resources are ready.
customize: Adjust recognition settings or model versions
resourcesMissing: Resources are not ready. Ask an administrator to prepare a compatible published version.
parametersRequired: This algorithm needs additional configuration. Complete the advanced settings.
noPermission: Your account needs permission to save, start, or install models. Contact an administrator.
withRule: Alert conditions are included. Adjust the detection area and confirmation settings under Alert conditions.
withoutRule: Recognition results are displayed by default. Configure Alert conditions to generate alerts.
